description.value:
You open your eyes, and whatever you have been holding goes out all at once.

Toggle Eyes Open on @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Om]. Your blindness lifts immediately, and the next Technique you cast or unarmed Strike you make before the end of this turn is empowered:

  • +2 damage dice per stack spent, and
  • a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks spent to any saving throw it allows.

Then delete @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Om]. That is the spend, and the stacks reset to 0.

Your eyes open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious — delete the effect without toggling.

Both numbers are automated off the effect's counter, which is why the effect stays on you until you have taken the empowered roll rather than vanishing the moment your eyes open. The save penalty is applied as an equal bonus to your Technique DC — the same number from the side Foundry can actually roll.
